Corky AR test

One scene, your phone, nothing to install

  1. Tap Start the test and allow the camera.
  2. If your phone offers real AR: aim at the floor or a table, move slowly, and tap to put Corky down. Then walk around him.
  3. Once he is standing, he gets a speech bubble about the demo wine (Messi's GOAT 10 Syrah) - tap again and he says it out loud.
  4. If your phone does not offer real AR, you get preview mode: Corky animated over your camera view, but he won't stay put in the room.
